hook: Analyzing long video files just got a whole lot easier.
body: Google just updated their flagship AI model, which is -- Gemini --, with agentic video understanding. Instead of just summarizing a clip, it now acts like an active agent. You can ask it to track complex timelines, pinpoint subtle visual changes, or even write code based on video demonstrations. It basically watches the video alongside you, processing hours of footage in seconds to find exactly what you need.
